sponsored.t: Includes avoidant/restrictive food intake disorders as eating disorders for the purposes of mental health
sponsored.sum: Includes avoidant/restrictive food intake disorders as eating disorders for the purposes of mental health.

sponsored.t: Relates to alternate jurors
sponsored.sum: Provides that after an alternate juror has been substituted, the jury shall deliberate anew on all issues submitted to the jury at the outset of deliberations; exempts issues for which a verdict was already rendered.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting amendment of a claim or notice of intention to file a claim to correct jurisdictional pleading defects
sponsored.sum: Permits amendment of a claim or notice of intention to file a claim to correct jurisdictional pleading defects and the dismissal of a claim based upon claimant's failure to comply with jurisdictional pleading requirements.

sponsored.t: Expands disclosure requirements for lobbyists
sponsored.sum: Expands disclosure requirements for lobbyists to include appropriations, gubernatorial or local executive orders and tribal-state agreements.

sponsored.t: Provides greater accountability in how contracts are procured by the state
sponsored.sum: Provides greater accountability in how contracts are procured by the state; provides that contracts comply with conflict of interest laws.

sponsored.t: Prohibits investment managers from assisting in investing moneys belonging to retirement system
sponsored.sum: Prohibits investment managers from assisting in investing moneys belonging to retirement systems; defines who qualifies as an investment manager.

sponsored.t: Creates the non-partisan legislative budget office
sponsored.sum: Creates the non-partisan legislative budget office; directs such office shall provide information to legislative committees of the senate and assembly with respect to the state budget, appropriation bills and other bills providing budget authority or tax expenditures; requires such office to report to the temporary president of the senate, the senate minority leader, the speaker of the assembly and the assembly minority leader.

sponsored.t: Requires additional disclosures from lobbyists
sponsored.sum: Requires additional disclosures from lobbyists including: campaign contributions to elected officials; existing business relationships or associations with public officials; and the names of family members of a public official to whom the lobbyist, or their employer, paid compensation of over $500 in the preceding calendar year and the amount of compensation paid; provides for the disposition of campaign funds.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring motor vehicle dealers to search for recalls and make certain repairs prior to selling a used motor vehicle
sponsored.sum: Requires motor vehicle dealers to search for recalls and make certain repairs prior to selling a used motor vehicle.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of investment managers in the New York state and local police and fire retirement system
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of investment managers in the New York state and local police and fire retirement system; defines who qualifies as an investment manager.

sponsored.t: Requires interest rates for debts be set to no more than one percentage point greater than the consumer price index for urban wage earners and clerical workers per annum
sponsored.sum: Requires interest rates for debts be set to no more than one percentage point greater than the consumer price index for urban wage earners and clerical workers per annum; removes collection fees outside of certain debts owed.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring public schools to offer plant-based food options in food service
sponsored.sum: Requires public schools to offer plant-based food options in food service.

sponsored.t: Provides representation to veterans for certain civil matters
sponsored.sum: Provides representation to veterans that are at or below four hundred percent of the federal poverty guidelines for matters involving children, sustenance and real property proceedings.

sponsored.t: Requires bike shares to equip all bicycles with electric assist with speed and location tracking technology
sponsored.sum: Requires bike shares to equip all bicycles with electric assist with speed and location tracking technology and to revoke customer account if such customers ride over the speed limit or against the flow of traffic.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the consideration of evidence that either parent has ever obtained or attempted to obtain reproductive health services relating to the termination of a pregnancy in certain legal proceedings
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the consideration of evidence that either parent has ever obtained or attempted to obtain reproductive health services relating to the termination of a pregnancy in certain legal proceedings.

sponsored.t: Requires contractors and subcontractors disclose any potential personal or professional relationship with public servants
sponsored.sum: Requires contractors and subcontractors disclose any potential personal or professional relationship with public servants and requires such contractor and subcontractor state they are in compliance with conflict of interest laws.

sponsored.t: Prohibits contractors from submitting claims and receiving payment from subcontractors who are not pre-authorized by a contracting city agency
sponsored.sum: Prohibits contractors from submitting claims and receiving payment from subcontractors who are not pre-authorized by a contracting city agency; establishes penalties.

sponsored.t: Establishes a state visa bond fund administered by the office for New Americans
sponsored.sum: Establishes a state visa bond fund administered by the office for New Americans funded entirely by private donations to assist persons in purchasing a visa bond for immigrants.

sponsored.t: Relates to the dispensing of certain prescriptions
sponsored.sum: Provides that mifepristone or misoprostol may be dispensed without the name and address of the dispenser and patient included on the prescription label.

sponsored.t: Relates to awards made to crime victims
sponsored.sum: Increases the amount for awards made to crime victims; specifies certain items of personal property which are necessary and essential to the welfare of a claimant.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "public leadership for obstructive weather from snow (PLOWS) act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "public leadership for obstructive weather from snow (PLOWS) act" which improves coordination between city run agencies for removing snow in response to a snow event.

sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the procurement of certain technology and products which pose a state or national security risk
sponsored.sum: Aligns state and local procurement laws with federal law prohibiting the procurement of certain technology and electronic parts or products which are determined to pose a risk to state and national security; relates to the authority of the office of information technology services to issue certain guidance relating thereto.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the Immigration and Customs Enforcement agency from enforcing the provisions of the Immigration and Nationality Act within one thousand feet of an area deemed a sensitive location
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the Immigration and Customs Enforcement agency from enforcing the provisions of the Immigration and Nationality Act within one thousand feet of an area deemed a sensitive location; defines sensitive location.

sponsored.t: Grants members of the city of New York's police force eligibility for retirement and pension based on previous service as traffic enforcement agents
sponsored.sum: Grants members of the city of New York's police force eligibility for retirement and pension based on previous service as traffic enforcement agents.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring balanced budgeting and spending; amends limitations on state supported debt; prohibits a message of necessity for budget bills
sponsored.sum: Requires balanced budgeting and spending; amends limitations on state supported debt; prohibits a message of necessity for budget bills; establishes the Rainy day fund as a constitutionally mandated provision.

sponsored.t: Increases the jurisdictional limits for county courts and district courts to fifty thousand dollars
sponsored.sum: Increases the jurisdictional limits for county courts and district courts to fifty thousand dollars.

sponsored.t: Relates to classification of transportation network company drivers as employees
sponsored.sum: Provides that transportation network company drivers shall be classified as employees under certain circumstances.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the climate and community investment act
sponsored.sum: Enacts the climate and community investment act; prioritizes the allocation of public investments in disadvantaged communities; addresses climate change challenges through the expansion and growth of clean and renewable energy sources; adopts best value requirements for the solicitation, evaluation and award of renewable energy projects; establishes a community just transition program; establishes a climate pollution fee and a household and small business energy rebate; creates the climate and community investment authority.

sponsored.t: Prohibits high-volume for-hire vehicle services from deactivating high-volume for-hire vehicle drivers
sponsored.sum: Prohibits high-volume for-hire vehicle services from deactivating high-volume for-hire vehicle drivers; establishes exceptions that allow deactivating drivers; and authorizes the office of the attorney general handle enforcement of the provisions outside the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain conditions for a grant of permission for access to adjoining property to make improvements or repairs
sponsored.ls: Real Property Actions and Proceedings Law
sponsored.sum: Relates to the notice required to be made for a grant of permission for access to adjoining property to make improvements or repairs.

sponsored.t: Direct the state police and department of transportation to conduct a study on the feasibility of installing available technologies to screen incoming cars to the state of New York for weapons
sponsored.sum: Directs the state police and department of transportation to conduct a study on the feasibility of installing available technologies to screen incoming cars to the state of New York for weapons; requires the state police to submit a report to the governor and legislature.

sponsored.t: Requires public employers who opt out of providing paid family leave benefits to provide parental leave in the alternative
sponsored.sum: Requires public employers who opt out of providing paid family leave benefits to provide parental leave in the alternative at the same pay rate and amount of time as paid family leave.

sponsored.t: Relates to granting academic credit at city or state operated institutions to veterans
sponsored.sum: Allows the granting of academic credit at state or city operated institutions to veterans.

sponsored.t: Establishes a task force to study and make recommendations on school safety in the state of New York
sponsored.sum: Establishes a task force to study the frequency and seriousness of violence that occurs on school grounds and the causes of such violence; and make recommendations on school safety in the state of New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting "Priscilla's law" requiring ebikes and electric scooters to be registered and have license plates.
sponsored.sum: Requires bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters in a city with a population of one million or more be registered with the department of motor vehicles and have a license plate affixed to such bicycle with electric assist or electric scooter.

sponsored.t: Requires bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters be registered, inspected and insured
sponsored.sum: Requires bicycles with electric assist and electric scooters be registered with the department of motor vehicles, inspected and have liability insurance; and have a license plate affixed to such bicycle with electric assist or electric scooter.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the "ghostbuster act"
sponsored.sum: Enhances enforcement of laws requiring proper and readable license plates and vehicle identification numbers; increases penalties including booting.

sponsored.t: Relates to campaign contributions by entities doing business with the city of New York pursuant to a retainer agreement or on a contingency basis
sponsored.sum: Provides that no contracts for services with the city of New York which are awarded on a contingency basis or through a retainer agreement shall be excluded from the definition of doing business with the city for purposes of campaign finance limitations for matching contributions.

sponsored.t: Establishes Diwali as a school holiday
sponsored.sum: Establishes the fifteenth day of the eighth month of the Indian calendar in each year, known as Diwali, as a school holiday.

sponsored.t: Establishes Diwali as a statewide school holiday
sponsored.sum: Establishes the fifteenth day of the month of Kartika on the Hindu calendar in each year, known as Diwali, as a statewide school holiday.

sponsored.t: Relates to permitting persons who have filed for asylum to work in New York state
sponsored.sum: Permits persons who have filed for asylum to work in New York State.

sponsored.t: Relates to creating a state office of algorithmic innovation
sponsored.sum: Creates a state office of algorithmic innovation to set policies and standards to ensure algorithms are safe, effective, fair, and ethical, and that the state is conducive to promoting algorithmic innovation.

sponsored.t: Relates to paid family leave after a stillbirth
sponsored.sum: Provides for paid family leave after a stillbirth.

sponsored.t: Excludes from state income tax unemployment compensation benefits
sponsored.sum: Excludes from state income tax up to $10,200 of unemployment compensation benefits earned by a resident of the state.

sponsored.t: Enacts the residential structure fire prevention act of 2025
sponsored.sum: Enacts the residential structure fire prevention act; provides a tax credit to homeowners who remove cock loft fire hazards in their homes; provides an insurance discount for the installation of smoke detecting alarm devices in cock lofts; provides that the repair of cock lofts for the purpose of fire prevention and safety shall be qualifying expenditures under state housing programs.

sponsored.t: Requires a 120-day warning period for violations at certain veterans' organization facilities
sponsored.sum: Requires a 120-day warning period for violations at congressionally chartered veterans' organization facilities.

sponsored.t: Authorizes certain local municipal agencies to use surveillance cameras to combat illegal dumping
sponsored.sum: Authorizes certain local municipal agencies to use surveillance cameras to combat illegal dumping.

sponsored.t: Requires employers to provide up to ten additional days of unpaid leave for absences due to domestic violence, a family offense, sexual offense, stalking or human trafficking
sponsored.sum: Requires employers to provide up to ten additional days of unpaid leave for absences when the employee or employee's family member has been the victim of domestic violence, a family offense, sexual offense, stalking or human trafficking upon the employee's request for reasons related to such offense or offenses.

sponsored.t: Directs the commissioner of the division of homeland security and emergency services to conduct a review of security of metropolitan transportation authority facilities
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of the division of homeland security and emergency services to conduct a review and analysis of the security measures taken at the transportation facilities of the metropolitan transportation authority and its subsidiaries; requires such director to issue confidential reports of their findings and recommendations.

sponsored.t: Relates to the non-therapeutic use of antimicrobial agents in animals
sponsored.sum: Imposes restrictions on non-therapeutic use of antimicrobial agents in animals in the absence of any clinical sign of disease in the animals.

sponsored.t: Establishes the veterans service organizations fund
sponsored.sum: Establishes the congressional chartered veterans service organizations fund; provides for gifts made to such fund on an individual's personal income tax return.

sponsored.t: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority to rename the Ozone Park-Lefferts Blvd subway station the Lefferts Blvd-Little Guyana subway station
sponsored.sum: Directs the metropolitan transportation authority to rename the Ozone Park-Lefferts Blvd station the Lefferts Blvd-Little Guyana station.

sponsored.t: Relates to exempting veterans organizations in New York city from city sewer and water charges
sponsored.sum: Exempts veterans organizations in New York city, as defined in section 452 of the real property tax law, from payment of city sewer and water charges.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring merchants to accept cash as payment for goods
sponsored.sum: Requires merchants to accept cash as payment for goods and services; permits the superintendent of financial services to provide exemptions based on certain criteria.

sponsored.t: Relates to paid leave for menstrual complications and menopause
sponsored.sum: Relates to providing four days of paid leave for menstrual complications and menopause.

sponsored.t: Relates to a small business tax credit for the employment of disabled persons
sponsored.sum: Establishes a small business tax credit for the employment of disabled persons.

sponsored.t: Relates to resettlement of asylum seekers
sponsored.sum: Prohibits municipal corporations from refusing resettlement of asylum seekers from other municipal corporations in the state, provided that the resettling municipal corporation covers the costs of such resettlement, and no property of the municipal corporation receiving such asylum seekers is used without such municipal corporation's consent.

sponsored.t: Relates to the entitlement to unpaid leave of absence for victims of domestic violence
sponsored.sum: Provides for unpaid leave of absence for victims of domestic violence; permits victims of domestic violence to take an unpaid leave of absence for twenty days from employment to address on-going domestic violence; defines "address on-going domestic violence"; contains provision to protect the individual's job position and benefits.

sponsored.t: Relates to job skills training programs and employment services for taxicab drivers
sponsored.sum: Directs the department of labor to provide notice of job skills training programs and employment services available to taxicab drivers seeking alternate employment who may need assistance with language instruction, financial literacy, social services, computer training and career counseling.

sponsored.t: Relates to the existing special eligible list for public employees
sponsored.sum: Provides that the governmental agency shall notify any person on a special eligible list, in writing, that their name will remain on such list for two years after the termination of military duty and shall be removed at the end of the two year period unless such person requests to remain on such list.

sponsored.t: Relates to veterans' eligibility for public housing
sponsored.sum: Relates to veterans' eligibility for public housing; expands eligibility requirements to include veterans of the recent conflicts; requires granting of a preference for public housing to veterans or families of veterans who have a military service connected disability.

sponsored.t: Relates to criminal history background checks for the purchase of three-dimensional printers capable of creating firearms
sponsored.sum: Requires a criminal history background check for the purchase of a three-dimensional printer capable of creating firearms; prohibits sale to a person who would be disqualified on the basis of criminal history from being granted a license to possess a firearm.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a coordinator for asylum seeker services
sponsored.sum: Establishes a coordinator for asylum seeker services to oversee the integration of services and benefits available to asylum seekers.

sponsored.t: Relates to the manufacturing of firearms
sponsored.sum: Relates to the manufacturing of firearms; requires any firearm manufactured by a three-dimensional printer to contain a unique identifying number and to be registered with the state police.

sponsored.t: Relates to authorizing certain health care professionals licensed to practice in other jurisdictions to practice in this state
sponsored.sum: Authorizes certain health care professionals licensed to practice in other jurisdictions to practice in this state.

sponsored.t: Relates to a sales tax exemption for zero-emission school buses
sponsored.sum: Exempts the sale of zero-emission school buses from sales and use taxes.

sponsored.t: Relates to the creation of the "No Hate NY" license plate and the "No Hate NY fund"
sponsored.sum: Relates to the creation of the "No Hate NY" license plate and the "No Hate NY fund" to support hate crime awareness and prevention programs.

sponsored.t: Relates to minimum wage requirements for public employees
sponsored.sum: Requires minimum wage for state and municipal employees.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the "empire state of mind act" relating to the treatment of mentally ill persons; repealer
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "empire state of mind act" relating to the treatment of mentally ill persons in the realm of treatment in mental health and addiction services facilities, the penal system and social services.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "New York affordable drug manufacturing act"
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "New York affordable drug manufacturing act" to direct the commissioner of health to enter into partnerships to increase competition, lower prices, and address shortages in the market for generic prescription drugs, to reduce the cost of prescription drugs for public and private purchasers, taxpayers, and consumers, and to increase patient access to affordable drugs.

sponsored.t: Requires certain civil court documents to be provided to parties in their native language
sponsored.ls: New York City Civil Court Act
sponsored.sum: Requires certain civil court documents to be provided to parties in their native language; requires parties to demonstrate their understanding of the nature and effect of such documents.

sponsored.t: Relates to the regulation of motorized scooters
sponsored.sum: Provides for the regulation of motorized scooters including registration, safety and equipment, prohibitions on unsafe operation and insurance requirements.

sponsored.t: Creates the consumer overdraft protection act
sponsored.sum: Creates the consumer overdraft protection act to ensure that consumers are informed of their options in regard to overdraft protection.

sponsored.t: Relates to the retail sale and on-site consumption of cannabis within one thousand feet of a school or child day care center
sponsored.sum: Prohibits cannabis retail and on-site consumption licensees from operating such premises within one thousand feet of school grounds or a child day care center.

sponsored.t: Relates to definition of a personal assistant under the consumer directed personal assistance program
sponsored.sum: Permits an eligible individual's parent, adult child or in-law relative to be a personal assistant under the consumer directed personal assistance program.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a central business district toll exemption for taxicabs
sponsored.sum: Establishes a central business district toll exemption for taxicabs.

sponsored.t: Relates to the designation of Diwali as a public holiday
sponsored.sum: Relates to the designation of Diwali, the Hindu festival of lights, as a public holiday.

sponsored.t: Relates to a reduced fare program in the metropolitan transportation authority for veterans who are students
sponsored.sum: Directs the MTA to establish a reduced fare program in the metropolitan transportation authority for veterans who are students.

sponsored.t: Relates to a reduced or free fare program in the MTA for disabled veterans
sponsored.sum: Directs the MTA to establish a reduced or free fare program for disabled veterans.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the rainy day act; repealer
sponsored.sum: Enacts the rainy day act; moves funds from the tax stabilization fund to the rainy day reserve fund; increases the maximum balance; requires certain deposits; prohibits establishment of funds except by statute.

sponsored.t: Relates to warranties and protections for purchasers of new and used motor vehicles
sponsored.sum: Provides certain warranties and protections for purchasers of new and used motor vehicles; includes commercial and business purchasers under the Lemon Law.

sponsored.t: Relates to state contracts for the services of pharmacy benefit managers under health insurance plans for state officers and employees
sponsored.sum: Requires state contracts for the services of pharmacy benefit managers under health insurance plans for state officers and employees to be procured pursuant to a reverse auction process.

sponsored.t: Creates the 3D printed housing and infrastructure task force
sponsored.sum: Creates the 3D printed housing and infrastructure task force to promote large scale construction of 3D printed homes and associated infrastructure with respect to legislation, regulatory environment, government initiatives and inducements.

sponsored.t: Relates to certain requirements for municipal gun buyback programs
sponsored.sum: Requires that firearms surrendered under a municipal gun buyback program shall be rendered inoperable, and all components unable to be reused; prohibits the acceptance of firearms which were manufactured for the purpose of surrender for remuneration.

sponsored.t: Requires license plates for e-bikes and electric scooters used for deliveries in certain cities
sponsored.sum: Requires registration and license plates for e-bikes and electric scooters used for deliveries in cities with a population of one million or more.

sponsored.t: Relates to improving safety for third-party food deliveries
sponsored.sum: Prohibits third-party food delivery platforms from employing algorithms that promote unsafe operation of e-bikes and scooters to improve safety for third-party food deliveries.

sponsored.t: Relates to a study of an autonomous rail rapid transit (ART) network in the city of New York
sponsored.sum: Directs the MTA to study the feasibility of developing and operating an autonomous rail rapid transit (ART) network in the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to the next generation 911 system, an emergency services internet protocol network
sponsored.sum: Requires the state shall offer a statewide emergency services internet protocol network (ESINet) available for connection to local public safety answering points (PSAPs).

sponsored.t: Establishes the maximum contaminant level goals (MCLGs) for emerging contaminants
sponsored.sum: Establishes the maximum contaminant level goals (MCLGs) for emerging contaminants; provides that the commissioner of health shall by regulation establish a maximum contaminant level goal (MCLG) for each emerging contaminant for which such commissioner has established; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Establishes a green development neighborhood tax exemption
sponsored.sum: Establishes a green development neighborhood tax exemption.

sponsored.t: Relates to prevailing wages for certain New York city service contracts
sponsored.sum: Requires prevailing wages for New York city service contracts to provide homecare services, day care services, head start services, services to persons with cerebral palsy, building services, food services or temporary services; removes references to living wage.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the "return on investment act"
sponsored.sum: Requires the state comptroller, and the NYC comptroller, to prepare an analysis of the return on investment of certain economic development programs and projects.

sponsored.t: Requires certain state employees to undergo annual cyber security training
sponsored.sum: Requires state employees who use a computer to complete at least twenty-five percent of such employees' required duties to undergo annual cyber security training.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing a statewide school safety tip line
sponsored.sum: Directs the commissioner of education to establish a statewide school safety tip line to permit students and others to report information related to incidents of students causing harm to the physical or mental health of another student or school employee, or a threat of such harm.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "appropriate appropriations act"; repealer
sponsored.sum: Enacts the "appropriate appropriations act" to prohibit lump sum budget appropriations and require itemized appropriations; limits the use of expenditures for emergencies; limits reappropriations.

sponsored.t: Relates to plans for safety net hospitals to increase revenue
sponsored.sum: Requires safety net hospitals to submit an annual plan for increasing or generating revenue.

sponsored.t: Relates to capitated payments under the medical assistance program
sponsored.sum: Requires capitated payments under the medical assistance program.

sponsored.t: Relates to establishing school threat assessment teams
sponsored.sum: Directs school districts to establish school threat assessment teams and implement plans to intervene where a student exhibits behavior indicating an intent to harm themselves or others and to address underlying needs of the student.

sponsored.t: Relates to work authorization for asylum seekers
sponsored.sum: Directs the comptroller to withhold certain payments to be made to the federal government until asylum seekers in the custody of the city of New York are granted documentation or authorization for employment.

sponsored.t: Prohibits the use of investment managers to assist with investments of monies in the common retirement fund
sponsored.sum: Prohibits the use of investment managers to assist with investments of monies in the common retirement fund; requires that all current contracts with investment managers not be renewed after a period of one year.

sponsored.t: Exempts certain business enterprise subcontractors who seek to do work with not-for-profit corporations from certain requirements
sponsored.sum: Authorizes certain business enterprise subcontractors who seek to do work with not-for-profit corporations to receive MWBE certification if certain criteria is met; imposes a $50,001 limit on the provision of such services or work; makes related provisions.

sponsored.t: Requires legislative fiscal impact notes to include objective calculations of anticipated economic impacts for next three years on state or subdivisions; repealer
sponsored.sum: Requires legislative fiscal impact notes to include objective calculations of anticipated economic impacts for next three years on state or political subdivisions.

sponsored.t: Establishes the New York state service corps, relates to the New York state service corps - health services track; repealer
sponsored.sum: Establishes the New York state service corps; relates to the New York state service corps - health services track.

sponsored.t: Authorizes the vacating of an arbitration award on the basis of arbitrator disregard of the law
sponsored.sum: Authorizes the vacating of an arbitration award on the basis of arbitrator disregard of the law.

sponsored.t: Relates to insurance in certain public construction contracts
sponsored.sum: Provides an exemption for the city of New York from certain insurance requirements in connection with public construction contracts for certain transportation facilities.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring certain town and village justices be admitted to practice law in the state
sponsored.sum: Relates to requiring certain town and village justices be admitted to practice law in the state; requires town and village justices in a town or village with a high arraignment volume be admitted to practice law in New York state for at least five years as of the date they commence the duties of office; provides the determination of a town or village with a high arraignment volume shall be made by the office of court administration in consultation with the division of criminal justice services.

sponsored.t: Relates to pre-approved construction documents
sponsored.sum: Requires municipalities which issue building permits to provide pre-approved construction documents at no cost for the types of residential buildings permitted to be constructed in such jurisdiction.

sponsored.t: Prohibits broad indemnification by a design professional of a state or local agency or political subdivision involving public work for contracts
sponsored.sum: Prohibits broad indemnification by a design professional of a state or local agency or political subdivision involving public work for contracts except to the extent that damages were caused by or the result of the negligence, recklessness, or willful misconduct of the design professional.

sponsored.t: Relates to registration and special plates for severely disabled veterans
sponsored.sum: Provides an exemption from registration and special plate fees for severely disabled veterans; includes veterans rated as 60% disabled by the US department of veterans affairs; removes the requirement of service in a time of war.

sponsored.t: Requires certain department of motor vehicle forms and applications to be available in Punjabi, Bengali and Hindi
sponsored.sum: Requires department of motor vehicle forms, tests and applications for permits and licenses in a city with a population of one million or more to be available in Punjabi, Bengali and Hindi.

sponsored.t: Relates to comprehensive services to individuals with a persistent pattern of involvement in the New York city criminal justice system
sponsored.sum: Directs the New York city mayor's office of criminal justice to provide comprehensive services to 9,000 individuals identified as having a persistent pattern of involvement in the New York city criminal justice system; provides that income from vocational programs shall not be considered for purposes of determining public assistance.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the "get nonprofits paid act"
sponsored.sum: Requires prompt payment within thirty days for not-for-profit organizations under procurement contracts with the city of New York.

sponsored.t: Relates to requiring responsible capability scaling policies
sponsored.sum: Requires certain companies which utilize artificial intelligence to file responsible capability scaling policies with the chief information officer.

sponsored.t: Enacts the "respect electoral audiovisual legitimacy (REAL) act"
sponsored.sum: Prohibits political communication containing any photo, video or audio depiction of a candidate created in whole or in part through the use of generative artificial intelligence.

sponsored.t: Increases the jurisdictional limits for small claims to fifteen thousand dollars
sponsored.sum: Increases the jurisdictional limits for small claims to fifteen thousand dollars.

sponsored.t: Relates to providing pension benefits to the widow of deceased firefighter Derek Floyd
sponsored.sum: Provides New York city fire pension fund benefits to the widow of deceased firefighter Derek Floyd.

sponsored.t: Relates to enacting the safe subways act creating a safety command force
sponsored.sum: Enacts the safe subways act creating a subway safety command force responsible for coordinating public safety, homelessness intervention services, the orderly flow of riders in and out of the subway system, compliance with fare collection, and the cosmetic appearance of subway trains and stations.

sponsored.t: Relates to disability benefits for pregnancy loss
sponsored.sum: Provides for disability benefits for pregnancy loss.

sponsored.t: Enacts "Penny's law" to create the offenses of negligent and reckless handling of a dog, codifies the requirement that dogs be restrained, and requires signs in parks that dogs must be restrained
sponsored.sum: Enacts "Penny's law" to create the offenses of negligent handling of a dog and reckless handling of a dog; codifies the requirement that dogs be restrained in New York city; requires signage in parks that all dogs must be restrained.

sponsored.t: Requires municipalities to submit a multi-year financial plan to the comptroller
sponsored.sum: Requires municipalities to submit a multi-year financial plan to the comptroller which shall identify actions necessary to achieve and maintain long-term fiscal stability.

sponsored.t: Authorizes municipalities and districts to enter into cooperative agreements for the provision of centralized public employee administrative and personnel services
sponsored.sum: Authorizes municipalities and districts to enter into cooperative agreements for the provision of centralized public employee administrative and personnel services; provides for health insurance coverage of municipal employees pursuant to standardized health insurance contracts; authorizes the provision of reduced premiums for municipal health insurance plans which offer wellness programs.

sponsored.t: Relates to eliminating the role of the federal centers for disease control and prevention from the determination of policies and practices in the state of New York
sponsored.sum: Eliminates the role of the federal centers for disease control and prevention from the determination of policies and practices in the state of New York; directs the use of nationally recognized clinical practice guidelines and best practices.

sponsored.t: Establishes a statewide legal services program for income-eligible domestic violence survivors
sponsored.sum: Establishes a statewide legal services program for income-eligible domestic violence survivors; requires reporting on the results of such program.

sponsored.t: Creates a universal stock fund which provides residents the ability to invest in New York state
sponsored.sum: Creates a universal stock fund which provides residents the ability to invest in New York state upon turning eighteen years old or moving into the state.

sponsored.t: Grants members of the city of New York's police force eligibility for retirement and pension based on previous service as traffic enforcement agents
sponsored.sum: Grants members of the city of New York's police force eligibility for retirement and pension based on previous service as traffic enforcement agents.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 120 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bills: Assembly Bill Number 1778-C, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the administrative code of the city of New York, in relation to granting members of the city's police force eligibil- ity for retirement and pension based on previous service as traf- fic enforcement agents" Assembly Bill Number 6756, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the retirement and social security law, in relation to providing certain death benefits to correction officers, correction officer-sergeants, correction officer-captains, assist- ant wardens, associate wardens or wardens employed by Orange coun- ty" Assembly Bill Number 6942, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the retirement and social security law, in relation to the restoration of 20 year service retirement for certain New York city corrections officers and sanitation…

sponsored.t: Relates to certificates of honorable separation from or service in the armed forces of the United States
sponsored.sum: Relates to certificates of honorable separation from or service in the armed forces of the United States; provides that such certificates shall be forwarded to the appropriate local veterans' service agency within 60 days of receipt.

veto.text: VETO MESSAGE - No. 104 TO THE ASSEMBLY: I am returning herewith, without my approval, the following bill: Assembly Bill Number 4649-A, entitled: "AN ACT to amend the veterans' services law, in relation to certif- icates of honorable separation from or service in the armed forces of the United States" NOT APPROVED This bill would require the department of veterans' services (DVS) to provide copies of certificates of release or discharge from active duty that they receive from the federal government to local veterans' service agencies. While the goal of this bill is laudable, the DVS is prohibited under federal law from freely sharing this information once they receive it. sponsored.t: Relates to prohibiting the procurement of certain technology and products which pose a state or national security risk
sponsored.sum: Aligns state and local procurement laws with federal law prohibiting the procurement of certain information and communications technology and electronic parts or products which are determined to pose a risk to state and national security.
